summary.text: At a glance: YARA INTERNATIONAL ASA is a public limited company (ASA) in Oslo, working in produksjon av gjødsel og nitrogenforbindelser; 536 registered employees and operating revenue NOK 3,620,000,000 in 2025, down 14% on 2024; website https://www.yara.com.

What's new (past 12 months, newest first): 2026-09-14 employee count updated: 536; 2026-08-12 employee count updated: 530; 2026-07-15 employee count updated: 535; 2026-06-23 industry code changed; 2026-06-15 board registration changed (chair: Helge Lund); 2026-06-13 employee count updated: 534; +7 more.
YARA INTERNATIONAL ASA (org. no. 986228608): Allmennaksjeselskap (ASA), founded 2003-11-10.

What it does: Primary industry: 20.150 Produksjon av gjødsel og nitrogenforbindelser. Registered purpose: Drive industri, handel og transport samt å drive annen virksomhet knyttet til disse formål. Virksomheten kan også drives ved deltagelse i eller i samarbeid med andre foretak.
Business address: Drammensveien 131, 0277 OSLO, Norge (OSLO municipality).
Size: 536 registered employees; latest filed company accounts (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31): operating revenue NOK 3,620,000,000, annual result NOK 10,989,000,000.
People: CEO (daglig leder): Svein Tore Holsether; board chair: Helge Lund; 10 other board members; auditor: DELOITTE AS.
Locations: 2 active sub-units registered (incl. OSLO, PORSGRUNN).
Status: no bankruptcy, liquidation or forced-dissolution flags registered.
Identity: share capital NOK 433,033,565.9 (registered 2022-08-25); formerly registered as AGRIHOLD ASA (until 2003-12-18).
Website: https://www.yara.com (as registered, and verified on the site).
Company-owned profiles linked from its website: https://facebook.com/yarainternational, https://instagram.com/yarainternational, https://youtube.com/user/yarainternationalasa.
Hiring: no active job ads on arbeidsplassen.no (NAV) for this company or its sub-units.

Changes: none since the previous check on 2026-11-06.
